title: DecisionRecord
description: Append-only audit primitive written (async) for every served price. One artifact serving four consumers: audit log, replay/debug source, training-set builder, drift-monitor input. The model_input snapshot makes any historical price exactly reproducible.

trace_id.description: Shared end-to-end: API → inference → guardrails → log.

trigger.description: What produced the price. signal_trigger = ADR-007 channel (closed signal set, corroboration required, still guardrailed).

trigger_evidence.description: Required when trigger = signal_trigger; absent otherwise.

confidence.description: ADR-007 rail: trigger confidence must be >= 0.90.

policy_arm.description: 5% holdout arm keeps the baseline policy so revenue drift has a measurable control (step-1 decision).

policy_pack.description: Which guardrail pack was applied (ADR-008) — answers 'which rule was in effect when we priced this?'.

model_input.description: Full feature snapshot as scored (or a ref to immutable storage holding it).

stale_features.description: Features served past TTL but below 3x TTL.

unclamped_price.description: Raw model output before guardrails — required for the explain/HITL view.

degraded.description: True when rule-based fallback or critical features were missing.

impact.description: Expected business impact of this price (their question 4). OPTIONAL: records written before this field existed simply lack it and stay valid. basis=current_velocity means projected_daily_margin is observed velocity × unit margin — NOT a forecast (forecast arrives with the forecasting module).

projected_daily_margin.description: unit_margin × demand_rate_24h × 24 — at current observed velocity; null when velocity is missing/stale-dropped

fingerprint.description: hash(request, model_version, feature_snapshot) — idempotency + replay key.

then.description: ADR-007 rail: a signal-triggered decision must carry its evidence (confidence >= 0.90 + corroboration).
Evidence belongs only to the signal_trigger channel — its absence elsewhere would hide provenance gaps.
